subject: Promote live view alert in SetAlwaysAttentive
description: SetAlwaysAttentive tested the music alert channel before promoting an attentive NPC, so an earlier ALERT_ONLY_MUSIC update could leave the live view alert green while music was already yellow and suppress Original's promotion. The native now tests view_alert_status, routes the update through the soldier alert wrapper, and rejects a resolved enemy without an actor entity ID instead of silently omitting its EnterAttentiveMode sequence. Focused mixed-channel and ordinary-branch controls pass. The representative clears its target and advances to an independent frame-784 mismatch.
